item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phrin las go rim
item.coloph: de ltar gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu yi/ gyer brda' rol mo'i bye brag mi nor ba'i/ brjed tho gsal bar bkod pa 'di nyid ni/ mtha' bzhi drang srong nyi ma tshul khrims kyi/ phyag len rim brgyud bla ma'i zhal gsungs nas/ 'khrul med legs par skyang sprul nam rgyal des/ bstan dang 'gro la byin rlabs char sbreng phyir/ bkod par bgyis la nor 'khrul gnong bshags shing / legs 'bras dkar po skal ldan gsos mchis shog/
